invariants.rationale: The method references node's fields and methods, so node cannot be null at exit.
index is used for insertion into rootNodes; negative indexes would likely be invalid.
At exit, node has been inserted at 'index', so index must be a valid position in rootNodes.
Method inserts node at position index in rootNodes, so node must be at that position at exit.
After insertion, node is always added as a root node, which has no parent.
